deals.whyRanked: $98 round trip (Nov 7–14) confirmed today on Allegiant's own fare search, a ninth straight day as the cheapest verified fare of the five, with the Smokies' Greenbrier entrance 45 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to explore alone on foot, and the park's Greenbrier and Cosby entrances are quieter than the Cades Cove side.

highlights: Market Square farmers market and street performers
Sunsphere observation deck over World's Fair Park
Ijams Nature Center quarry swimming hole
Knoxville Museum of Art
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Arrive, walk the Riverwalk along the Tennessee River, dinner in the Old City.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Greenbrier: the Ramsey Cascades or Porters Creek trailhead, back by early evening.
Day 3 — Market Square farmers market and the Knoxville Museum of Art before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Ijams are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is required to reach the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square or Gay Street — walkable, close to restaurants and the Tennessee Theatre.

deals.whyRanked: One-way legs holding at $59 confirmed live on JetBlue's own booking page today, steady for a third straight check, with Shenandoah National Park about 75 minutes out and the highest solo score of the five.
deals.soloWhy: The Metro reaches nearly every monument and museum, the Mall is safe to walk solo well into the evening, and the Smithsonians are free.

highlights: National Mall monuments at sunrise before the crowds
Smithsonian museums (all free)
National Archives to see the original Constitution
Great Falls Park overlook on the Potomac
Shenandoah's Skyline Drive
itinerary: Day 1 — Smithsonian Air and Space and Natural History museums in the morning, Mall monuments at sunset.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Shenandoah: Skyline Drive to the Stony Man or Hawksbill summit trailhead.
Day 3 — Georgetown waterfront and C&O Canal towpath, Eastern Market lunch before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Metro covers the Mall, museums, and most neighborhoods; a rental car is only needed for Shenandoah or Great Falls.
guide.stayArea: Near a Metro stop on the Orange/Blue/Silver line (Capitol Hill or Foggy Bottom) for the fastest reach to the Mall.

deals.whyRanked: One-way legs holding at $80 confirmed live on JetBlue's own booking page today, unchanged for a third straight check, with Everglades day trips an hour inland.
deals.soloWhy: Las Olas Boulevard and the beachfront promenade stay busy and walkable well into the evening, with the free Sun Trolley covering downtown.

highlights: Las Olas Boulevard shops and cafes
Fort Lauderdale beachfront promenade
Riverwalk and the NSU Art Museum
Everglades Shark Valley bike loop
Bonnet House Museum & Gardens
itinerary: Day 1 — Water taxi along the Riverwalk in the morning, Las Olas Boulevard shops in the afternoon.
Day 2 — Everglades NP Shark Valley: rent a bike for the 15-mile paved loop, alligators guaranteed.
Day 3 — Bonnet House gardens at opening, beachfront promenade at sunset before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Sun Trolley covers downtown and the beach; a rental car is worth it for the Everglades day trip.
guide.stayArea: Las Olas or the beachfront — walkable, close to restaurants and the water taxi stops.

deals.whyRanked: One-way legs holding at $95 confirmed live on JetBlue's own booking page today, unchanged for a third straight check, with the free downtown streetcar and Ybor City making it an easy add to the cheap-Florida run alongside Fort Lauderdale.
deals.soloWhy: The free TECO Line streetcar links downtown, the Riverwalk, and Ybor City, so evenings out don't require a car or rideshare.

highlights: Tampa Riverwalk (2.5 miles, connects downtown's museums)
Ybor City's cigar factories, bars, and Cuban sandwiches
Florida Aquarium
Tampa History Center
Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park
itinerary: Day 1 — Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park and the Tampa Riverwalk at sunset.
Day 2 — Free streetcar to Ybor City: cigar factory tours, 7th Avenue murals, Columbia Restaurant for dinner.
Day 3 — Florida Aquarium and Tampa History Center before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free TECO Line streetcar connects downtown, the Channel District, and Ybor City; a rideshare covers the beaches, which are 30-45 minutes out.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the Channel District — walkable to the Riverwalk and a streetcar ride from Ybor City.

deals.whyRanked: One-way legs edged down to $103 on JetBlue's site today (from $106), holding it just ahead of Denver — whose one-way fare climbed to $119 after its flash sale expired — with the Chattahoochee River's Sope Creek trails inside city limits.

nearbyParks.name: Chattahoochee River National Recreation Area (Sope Creek)

deals.soloWhy: The Beltline and MARTA rail make the core walkable and transit-friendly, though the metro area is spread out enough that a rideshare budget helps for anything outside it.

highlights: Atlanta Beltline Eastside Trail
Centennial Olympic Park and Georgia Aquarium
Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park
Ponce City Market
Chattahoochee River NRA's Sope Creek trails
itinerary: Day 1 — Sweet Auburn Historic District and the MLK National Historical Park in the morning, Ponce City Market for dinner.
Day 2 — Sope Creek trails at Chattahoochee River NRA, back by early afternoon for the Beltline Eastside Trail.
Day 3 — Centennial Olympic Park and the Georgia Aquarium before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: MARTA rail connects the airport, downtown, and Midtown; a rideshare or rental car helps for the Beltline's far ends and Sope Creek.
guide.stayArea: Midtown near Piedmont Park — walkable to the Beltline and a short MARTA ride from downtown.
food: Busy Bee Cafe (soul food, Vine City)
